root_cause: Overcharged MDR due to incorrect fee configuration for RuPay credit UPI transactions.
diagnosis: The fee charged (Rs 295.98) exceeds the expected fee (Rs 193.03) by Rs 102.95, indicating the acquirer applied a higher rate than the merchant's contract.
action_rationale: Auditing the gateway fee configuration will reveal and correct the misapplied rate, preventing future leakage.
